events.name: Maruti Suzuki Swift Devils Circuit Ahmedabad
events.venue: Malhaar Exotica, behind Dahegam Power Grid, Nehru Chokdi, Dahegam
events.registration_notes: Wave-based entry; individual waves sell out and close separately. Remaining waves close on 18 Oct 2026.
events.summary: The Ahmedabad leg of Devils Circuit, India's largest obstacle course race series, run by Spectacom Global across 12 cities in the 2026-27 season. Each leg is a 5 km course with 15 military-style obstacles, with timed competitive waves and untimed non-competitive waves. The fastest competitive finishers qualify for the Grand Finale on 14 March 2027, where the season's top man and woman win a Maruti Suzuki Swift.

categories.name: Competitive Pro (Wave A)
categories.eligibility: Limited to 100 elite participants; first wave on a fresh course
categories.notes: Podium standard: men 15 obstacles under 50 min, women 13 obstacles under 70 min.

categories.name: Competitive
categories.notes: Timed. Podium standard: men all 15 obstacles under 50 min, women 13 of 15 under 70 min, Masters (men 40+) 15 under 60 min. Top 25 qualify for the Grand Finale. City prizes Rs 30,000 / 15,000 / 5,000.

categories.name: Non-Competitive
categories.notes: Untimed for ranking; obstacles can be skipped.

course.surface: grass, dirt and mud with water obstacles
course.description: 5 km course with 15 military-style obstacles including Brain Freeze and the Summit. Venue at Dahegam, about 30 km north-east of Ahmedabad; coordinates approximate.

highlights: 5 km, 15 obstacles
Top 25 competitive finishers per city qualify for the Grand Finale (14 Mar 2027)
Season winner (men and women) gets a Maruti Suzuki Swift and Rs 1 lakh
tips: Venue is at Dahegam, about 30 km from central Ahmedabad: plan a car pool and leave early for 07:00-09:40 waves
Reach the venue 60-90 minutes before your wave; your start time is in the confirmation email and on your bib
No showers on site: carry a towel and a full change of clothes, and leave watches and jewellery at home
One bag per participant at the baggage counter; parking is limited and first come, first served
Each participant can bring one spectator, who collects a band at registration against your bib
amenities: Water on course and in the village
